decisions.rationale: Six days in with zero activity: no first project, no invite, no key milestone, no tickets, and no reply to either outreach ([email:186dac2d], [email:f0a375f2]). Fully silent Starter accounts that haven't created a project by day 6 rarely self-start within the remaining 8 days.

draft.subject: Getting Cedar Group's first project started
draft.body:
Hi Victor,

Following up on my last note — no reply needed, I just want to make the first step easy. In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so getting one project up is usually the thing that makes everything else click. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through your first project with you and answer anything about how your team works day to day.

Best,
Nadia
